name_en: Naruto kintoki — red-skinned, fluffy sweet potato from Naruto's seaside sand
summary_ja: 鳴門市を中心に、海に近い砂地の畑で育つさつまいも。高系14号から選ばれた系統とされ、鮮やかな紅色の皮と黄色い中身、ほくほくした粉質の食感が持ち味という。海砂を入れた水はけのよい畑が、色と甘みを決めると伝わる。
summary_en: A sweet potato grown in sandy fields near the sea, centered on Naruto. Said to be a line selected from the Kokei No. 14 variety, it is known for bright red skin, yellow flesh and a dry, fluffy texture. Well-drained fields dressed with sea sand are said to shape both its color and sweetness.
source_title: 徳島県公式ウェブサイト
